conviction_note: Event confirmed for 2026-10-28 inside the session (kabutan lists 3778 under 取引時間中の発表; the last two prints went out at 12:30 JST), so the window runs from the 10:05 sealed spot of 3,095 to the 10/29 close. The one company-level lever is the forecast: the 7/28 revised H1 guide (OP 2,200m yen) implies Q2 OP of 970m after Q1's 1,230m, and FY 2,500m implies only 300m in H2. Against that, the company itself said Q1 was flattered by deferred costs and capitalised development, a 26.0bn yen Rubin GPU order lands in January (depreciation before revenue), and the IFIS street figure (FY OP 4,706m, two analysts, inconsistent with its own ordinary 2,834m) already sits far above any plausible raise. So I lean only slightly up. abs_move 9 is set on this name's own reactions (median about 12% on the actual release dates, 9.6 proxy) and is not cut for my doubt about the sign. The scaled +0.54 sits below the +0.90 findings sum because p_up 53 carries the bar dispute and the cost-timing caveat.

findings.finding: Sakura's own revised H1 guide (OP 2,200m) needs only 970m of Q2 operating profit after a record Q1 of 1,230m, and FY OP 2,500m implies just 300m for H2. The company said GPU utilisation stays high and project start dates were pulled forward, so an H1 beat and a FY raise at this print are more likely than not. The offsets are all in the company's own documents: Q1 was helped by lower power costs, capitalised government-cloud development and deferred expenses; growth investment starts in Q2; and the 26.0bn yen NVIDIA Rubin purchase delivers in January 2027, adding depreciation before revenue. The street (IFIS FY OP 4,706m) already sits above any raise the company is likely to make.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Actual release dates from the Yahoo daily tape. 2026-07-28: H1 and FY raised, +9.3% close-to-next-close. 2026-04-27: initial FY27 OP guide of 1,500m, −12.9%. 2025-07-28: guide cut, −18.5%. 2025-10-28 H1 print, no guide change, −1.5%. 2024-10-28 H1 print, +63.5%. Guidance changes are what move this name, in both directions, by about 10%.
findings.why_not_priced: The H1 arithmetic is public, but the share price has given back everything since the 7/28 raise: it closed 3,100 on 7/28 and was 2,845 on 10/23 after the October AI de-rating. A market expecting a large raise would not trade below the post-raise level, while a market pricing in no raise would not sit with a 5,473 street target. The stock moved with the AI-sector tape (kabutan 10/27 market note: the Nikkei fell about 8,500 yen in 13 sessions on profit-taking in AI names), not with anything company-specific. What is not priced is the size of the FY revision, and that is the coin I am leaning on. The lean is small because the company itself flagged that Q1 profit was flattered by cost timing, and because a 26bn yen GPU purchase landing in Q4 makes a hold of the FY OP plan a real possibility.
findings.independence: Independent of the company: kabutan 2026-07-28 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3778&b=n202607280915) reports that investment expands from Q2, which is the cost side, consistent with the same document rather than independent of it. FY26 record: actual OP −403m against a revised −500m, a slight beat of its own revised guide (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3778&b=k202604270011). Global GPU rental tightness through H1 2026 (SemiAnalysis via https://www.itiger.com/news/1185188896, snippet_only) supports high utilisation. It is a proxy only.

findings.finding: Both October hits the stock took fall outside the reported quarter and outside the GPU business that drives profit. The 10/22 −8.4% followed a PHP-vulnerability function stop on the rental-server side, and every Japanese host patched the same flaw on 10/22. The 10/15 −9.3% gap came in a sector-wide AI sell-off. Neither touches Q2 (July to September).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance on this line. After the August 2026 unauthorized-access disclosure the stock fell sharply (kabutan 8/20) and then retook 4,000 by 8/28 (kabutan 9/03), which is one case of an operational scare being looked through within weeks.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced, and the stock is already +4.3% this morning. If the market had fully looked through these two drops, the price would be back near the 3,500-3,700 range of early October rather than at 3,095. The margin-long overhang (4.44x) is the reason some of the drop may not reverse, so this is sized small.
findings.independence: jinrai.co.jp 2026-10-22 (https://jinrai.co.jp/blog/2026/10/22/php2shell-hosting-response-status-2026-10/) says the PHP flaw was industry-wide and that hosts patched it on 10/22 (snippet_only). kabutan 10/27 market note (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3778&b=n202610271043) covers the sector-wide AI sell-off.

findings.finding: Q2 may book response costs for the August 2026 unauthorized-access incident (1,360,563 member accounts possibly exposed), most likely below operating income. The company said on 9/10 that the FY impact is limited and that no revision is planned.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the 8/19 disclosure the stock fell sharply on 8/20 (kabutan) and recovered to 4,000 by 8/28. No print has yet carried an incident cost.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the company quantified it as limited with no revision. What is left is the chance of an extraordinary loss line in the H1 net profit. That is a one-off with no path to the guide, so it is sized at a fraction.
findings.independence: The 8/19 disclosure (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260819/140120260819523094.pdf) is the same issuer, so not independent.

outside_window.finding: The 26.0bn yen NVIDIA HGX Rubin NVL8 investment delivers in January 2027. Its revenue ramp and depreciation fall in Q4 FY27 and FY28, and its funding (debt, subsidy or equity) has not been announced.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: likely to be at least considered. Q1 already covered 56% of the H1 OP guide and 49% of the FY guide, and H2 implied OP is 300m, but Rubin depreciation and growth spend argue for holding the FY plan. The street (IFIS OP 4,706m) is far above the company plan and internally inconsistent. Returns: none expected (5.5 yen year-end dividend). New-year guide: n/a at H1. Quarter: Q2 OP needs only 970m against Q1's 1,230m; Q1 progress of 49% of the FY plan compares with negative progress in FY26 and 23% (231 of a lower plan) in FY25 Q1, so it is unusually high.

baseline_tension: Agrees mildly with the priced lean (+0.88: modest short, heavy run-down) and cuts against the margin overhang. The strongest positive the release could carry is a FY OP raise to 3,500m or more, toward the street; I looked for evidence of it and found only the arithmetic, not a document. The strongest negative is a held FY plan read as an H2 profit slump, delivered into 4.44x margin longs.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: rule 1 (a negative resting on public 月次 or 進捗率) does not apply because the only negative is a company-quantified one-off already sized small; rule 2 (negatives outnumbering positives) is answered in baseline_tension, where the strongest positive is written out and was searched for
